changes.comment: `prerender.mjs`: prerender a package's site from workspace source through `@excom/nucleus-ssr` (a package's `build:prerender` script; `rush build:prerender`), printing one line per page; it exits non-zero when a page fails or when an internal link in a prerendered page leads to no page
The sitemap lists every doc page of a package, including pages of packages without a `docs-sections.json`
A root `server.ts` entry builds ESM only, with no UMD file, like `testing.ts`
`preview` serves a built site as Cloudflare Pages does: the 200 rewrites of `_redirects`, the headers of `_headers`, `/a/b/` moved to `/a/b`, and `404.html` with a 404 for an unknown page

Docs markdown: a custom element alone on its lines is no longer wrapped in `

`, which a browser's parser ends at the first block element the custom element renders
